metadata.title: Central kinematics of the Galactic globular cluster M80

notes: No eligible stars. The paper individually identifies two high-velocity stars, HV-MS and HV-SG, near the M80 centre (T:p8-b5; labels in T:p7-b1), and states that their radial velocities exceed M80's central escape speed and that they are not gravitationally bound to the cluster (T:p8-b5, T:p9-b4). That establishes cluster-unbound status, not present-day unboundness from the Milky Way; the paper also leaves foreground-star, binary-motion, and scattering explanations open (T:p9-b1, T:p9-b2, T:p9-b5, T:p9-b6). No other individually identified star is presented as a Galactic unbound candidate.
